sysroot.why: the TS 18661 _FloatN types are not in the front end's type system, and their prototypes derail the parse of <stdlib.h>

sysroot.change: the AdvSIMD and SVE guards are forced closed
sysroot.why: the SIMD math prototypes are written in GCC's built-in vector types (__Float32x4_t, __SVFloat32_t), which the front end has no syntax for

sysroot.change: form feeds and vertical tabs are deleted
sysroot.why: C makes both white space (C11 6.4p1); the front end reports a form feed as a stray token, and glibc's regex.h uses one as a page break, which alone refuses every unit that includes it

sysroot.change: renamed out of the search path
sysroot.why: it is a wrapper whose whole body is `#include_next <stdint.h>`, and the front end ignores #include_next, so keeping it hides the C library's real stdint.h and leaves intmax_t undeclared
